deliverables.purpose: A2 portrait main poster — the primary deliverable and consistency anchor for the entire visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: Dark ink background, bold geometric composition in accent colors, oversized Space Grotesk 'IEEE VIS 2026', dates Nov 9-13 2026, Boston MA, all three logos in correct lockup, 8px grid alignment visible.

deliverables.purpose: Square key visual / master visual — the campaign seed that proves the visual idea works standalone
deliverables.acceptance_test: Same visual language as poster in square format. Geometric forms, bold typography, dark background, accent colors. Works as standalone campaign image.

deliverables.purpose: Typography system board demonstrating type scale, weights, and hierarchy across all roles
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows Space Grotesk display/headline, Inter body/caption, JetBrains Mono data. Clear hierarchy from display to caption. Dark background. All type roles labeled.

deliverables.purpose: Color palette and visual rules board documenting the system for cross-format consistency
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows all 8 palette tokens as swatches with hex values. Shows geometric motif examples. Shows format adaptation logic. Dark background. Systematic layout.

deliverables.purpose: Twitter/X post (1200x675) — social adaptation for Twitter feed
deliverables.acceptance_test: 16:9 landscape. Dark background, geometric forms, bold type, IEEE VIS 2026 + dates + Boston. Logos present. Readable at social scroll size.

deliverables.purpose: Twitter/X header (1500x500) — wide banner format for profile header
deliverables.acceptance_test: Wide 3:1 horizontal. Dark background with geometric composition spanning full width. Conference name prominent. Logos visible. Works as profile banner.

deliverables.purpose: LinkedIn post (1200x627) — social adaptation for professional network
deliverables.acceptance_test: Similar to Twitter post with slightly different ratio. Same visual system. Professional tone. Dark background, geometric forms, bold type, conference info, logos.

deliverables.purpose: Instagram post (1080x1080) — square format for Instagram feed
deliverables.acceptance_test: Square format. Dark background, bold geometric composition centered. Conference name dominant. Accent colors. Logos. Works as square social post.

deliverables.purpose: Instagram story (1080x1920) — vertical full-screen format for Instagram stories
deliverables.acceptance_test: Vertical 9:16 format. Dark background, geometric forms adapted to tall format. Conference info stacked vertically. Logos. Bold typography. Full-screen story.

deliverables.purpose: Conference badge (100x70mm) and lanyard design — physical touchpoint at venue
deliverables.acceptance_test: Badge mockup with IEEE VIS 2026 logo, name placeholder, dates, role label. Lanyard with pattern or text. Dark badge, accent lanyard. Logos legible at small size.

deliverables.purpose: PPT/Keynote template (16:9) — title slide and content slide shown as composite
deliverables.acceptance_test: Two slides shown: title slide with full conference info and geometric background, content slide with clean layout and subtle geometric accent. Dark backgrounds, consistent typography, logos on title.

deliverables.purpose: Single polished self-contained presentation page with clear sections for final deliverables, design-system context, and research provenance
deliverables.acceptance_test: Embeds every required final PNG in a primary Final Deliverables section; inline CSS; no JS; no external assets; renders palette swatch row and type stack callout from design_system.json at top; shows reference assets in a secondary Reference Library section.
